effective_date: Upon full execution by all parties
purpose: I run a small commercial cleaning company and need a professional service agreement for a new office client. We’ll clean their building three nights per week after hours, including restrooms, trash removal, vacuuming, kitchen wipe-downs, and monthly deep cleaning. I need clear terms for pricing, payment due dates, late fees, extra charges for emergency cleanups or added rooms, access/alarm responsibility, damage reporting, supply ownership, cancellation notice, liability limits, photo permission for before/after results, and a process for requesting additional services. I want something clean, trustworthy, easy to review together, collaborate on changes if needed, and sign digitally once finalized.
title: Agreement
